name: Five-color walk
prompt: Step outside and find one real object in each of five colors. No photos; let the walk be the record.

name: Sound-map pause
prompt: Sit or stand outside. Point toward every sound you hear, then notice the farthest one.

name: Weather texture study
prompt: Find three surfaces changed by today's weather and compare their color, shine, and texture.

name: Block interval walk
prompt: Alternate one block brisk and one block easy. Turn around after five cycles.

name: Park loop ladder
prompt: Walk one loop, jog one loop, then finish with the fastest comfortable half-loop.

name: Shade-to-shade circuit
prompt: Move between five shaded spots, pausing for three slow breaths at each one.

name: Leaf palette
prompt: Arrange fallen leaves from light to dark, admire the gradient, then scatter them back.

name: One-page field sketch
prompt: Take paper and draw one outdoor scene using only lines—no erasing and no screen.

name: Snow shadow gallery
prompt: Use footprints and safe found objects to make three temporary shapes in untouched snow.

name: Ten-piece tidy
prompt: Bring gloves and a bag, collect ten pieces of litter, and dispose of them safely.

name: Tree-well check
prompt: Visit three nearby trees, remove only loose litter, and note which one needs water or city attention.

name: Pollinator minute
prompt: Watch one flowering patch for ten minutes and count visits without touching the insects.

name: Two-person noticing walk
prompt: Invite someone outside. Take turns pointing out one thing the other person missed.

name: Walk-and-call loop
prompt: Call someone you like, walk a familiar loop, and end the call when you return.

name: Sidewalk hello mission
prompt: Take a short walk and offer a simple hello to three people, with no need to start a conversation.

name: Unchosen turn
prompt: At the next three safe intersections, take the direction you use least. Return by a known route.

name: Micro-habitat hunt
prompt: Find three tiny habitats—a crack, log, wall, or puddle—and observe life without disturbing it.

name: Landmark triangle
prompt: Choose three visible landmarks and make a safe loop connecting all three without navigation apps.
